issues.where: across the entire frame (also in crops set-B-08.png and set-B-09.png)
issues.what: flat, perfectly geometric concentric blue-grey rings with uniform colour and crisp vector edges sit over a nearly featureless dark navy ocean, reading as a 2D graphic or debug overlay rather than real footage
issues.fix: remove the concentric ring graphic or shader artifact and render a natural ocean surface with realistic wave detail, reflections, and atmospheric depth

issues.what: the cyclone is an overly tight, uniform mathematical spiral with a sharp black circular eye and noisy arms, reading as a painted swirl rather than a real storm system
issues.fix: replace the procedural swirl with layered, asymmetric cloud bands, volumetric depth, and cast shadows consistent with the rest of the cloud deck

issues.where: coastlines across all islands and continents, especially top-right crop x 42 to 58% y 25 to 42% (also in set-B-01.png, set-B-03.png, set-B-04.png, set-B-05.png, set-B-06.png)
issues.what: every shoreline is traced by a uniform glowing cyan outline regardless of terrain slope, water depth, or sun angle, with visible dotted aliasing along the edge in set-B-03.png bottom-left
issues.fix: replace the uniform coastal stroke with physically varied bathymetry gradients, breaking surf only where scale permits, and natural water-to-land transitions

issues.where: bottom-left crop x 83 to 100% y 25 to 42% (also in set-B-01.png, set-B-04.png, set-B-05.png)
issues.what: the sunlit ocean on the right reads as flat matte beige-tan with no specular wave texture or depth, filling enclosed bays with solid flat tan up to a hard grey shoreline
issues.fix: add directional micro-wave roughness and realistic sun-glint falloff across the water surface and vary shallow-bay shading

issues.where: bottom-right crop x 0 to 17% y 58 to 75% and top-left crop (also in set-B-03.png, set-B-05.png, set-B-06.png)
issues.what: clouds read as flat, blurry noise-stamped cotton blotches with no volumetric self-shadowing and no cast shadows on the ocean or land beneath them
issues.fix: render clouds with sunlit tops, shadowed undersides, varied altitudes, and matching offset shadows cast onto the surface below

issues.where: bottom-left crop x 83 to 100% y 25 to 42% and top-right crop x 42 to 58% y 25 to 42% (also in set-B-01.png, set-B-03.png, set-B-04.png, set-B-05.png, set-B-06.png)
issues.what: mountain ridges form overly regular comb-like ribs resembling a procedural heightmap, while smaller offshore islands are smooth, featureless dark brown clay-like shapes with no atmospheric haze across the landmass
issues.fix: break up ridge regularity with varied geological erosion and rock/vegetation materials, add surface detail to smaller islands, and apply physically based aerial scattering across the planet

issues.where: upper-middle of the left continent (also in set-B-04.png)
issues.what: the orange volcanic glow appears as an airbrushed radial spot that does not realistically illuminate surrounding terrain or nearby vapour
issues.fix: ground the emission in terrain fissures or caldera geometry and let the light scatter through nearby smoke and atmosphere

issues.where: right crop x 83 to 100% y 58 to 75% (also in set-B-06.png)
issues.what: the open ocean shows stretched diagonal noise streaks rather than coherent ocean swell or sun-glint variation
issues.fix: replace the stretched noise texture with isotropic multi-scale wave normals and natural atmospheric haze

issues.where: top-left and bottom-right crops (also in set-B-07.png and set-B-09.png)
issues.what: the water background is a flat dark navy tint with a few isolated soft cloud smudges and faint warm edge smears that lack depth, reflection, or shadow
issues.fix: give the ocean surface realistic specular response, depth variation, and coherent cloud-to-water lighting
